comments.note: A09 — Security Logging & Monitoring: The PUT /:wid handler now persists a 'notes' field but there is no audit log entry when notes (or description) is updated. This is consistent with the pre-existing behaviour for the description field — no regression introduced. For a future hardening pass, consider logging sensitive field mutations (who changed what, when) if multi-user access is ever added.

A04 — Insecure Design (Info): The 'notes' field accepts any string value up to the 1 MB body cap enforced by parseJsonBody. There is no per-field length constraint (e.g. 10 000 characters). This is consistent with how 'description' was already handled. Risk is low given this is a local-only tool, but a field-level length cap would improve resilience for any future networked deployment.

No other security findings — all OWASP Top 10 categories reviewed. Input validation is correct (typeof string guard + 1 MB body limit). No new dependencies introduced. No SQL/template/shell injection vectors. No secrets or hardcoded credentials. Error responses do not expose stack traces. STABLE workspace invariant is preserved by the storage layer and not affected by this change.
